subject: Exclusive Notice of Range 14 Closure Window

paragraphs.text: I am writing exclusively to advise you that Range 14 closes for scheduled maintenance from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.
Please direct your subordinate commanders to reschedule live-fire iterations before 25 July 2026 through the Range Facility Management Support System.
My point of contact for this action is Mr. David Okonkwo, ATZB-RC, at 719-555-0142 or david.a.okonkwo.civ@army.mil.
